eth2 specs `v1.0.1` -- Contractual Control -- released!
https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/releases/tag/v1.0.1

Note, this is non-substantive wrt clients/consensus. It adds the specification of the 0x01 withdrawal credential to be used by validators.
